shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile in low relief on a T-shaped pillar face
relief carving on a broad flat vertical surface
animal with head shown facing the viewer's right / turned head
justification: Both show low-relief animal figures carved on the broad face of a T-shaped monolith, and in both a quadruped is rendered in profile with schematic outlined limbs, which is the most specific correspondence. A is densely populated with a whole programme — a row of arched/quadruped figures along the top, a band of zigzag/geometric ornament, felines, small human-like figures, a snake-like sinuous form and a large bird — whereas B carries just one isolated, sparse animal on an otherwise blank surface, so the composition and density differ greatly.
